All contributions (pull requests, bug reports, feature requests, etc) are subject to the following LLM (large language model / AI) policy and disclosure.

# Disclosure
All submissions must answer:
> Was your contribution assisted or generated in any way by a large language model (AI)? If so, please describe where and how. Be specific.

# Policy
* Pull requests are expected to have their code fully reviewed to ensure it meets all merge criteria.

* If the maintainers believe that a contribution was generated by a LLM with no or little to no human oversight, the pull request will be closed with extreme prejudice.

* Pull requests that have commits co-authored by LLMs will be closed with extreme prejudice.

* Contributions that have non-code AND non-text (music, graphics, etc) content created by LLMs will be closed with extreme prejudice.

* Contributions that appear to have code OR text content primarily created by LLMs will be closed with extreme prejudice. 

* If you are using an LLM, it is expected that you have thoroughly understood, reviewed, and edited everything in your contribution.
